label: ZKN_ZA_0001_000
text:
A strange seed was planted on its back at birth.
The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0002_000
text:
There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs
nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large
flower.

label: ZKN_ZA_0003_000
text:
After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells
stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0004_000
text:
The flame on its tail indicates Charmander’s life
force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

label: ZKN_ZA_0005_000
text:
It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe.
It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp
claws.

label: ZKN_ZA_0006_000
text:
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an
altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high
temperatures.

label: ZKN_ZA_0007_000
text:
It hides in its shell to protect itself, then strikes
back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0008_000
text:
When tapped on its head, this Pokémon will pull
it in, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0009_000
text:
It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause
fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its
shell.

label: ZKN_ZA_0013_000
text:
Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a
sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of
its head.

label: ZKN_ZA_0014_000
text:
Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can
only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in
danger.

label: ZKN_ZA_0015_000
text:
They may appear in a swarm. Beedrill flies at
violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the
toxic stinger on its rear.

label: ZKN_ZA_0016_000
text:
It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If
disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

label: ZKN_ZA_0017_000
text:
This Pokémon has a sprawling territory and will
fiercely peck at any intruder.

label: ZKN_ZA_0018_000
text:
It flies over water as it hunts, skimming along the
surface to catch Magikarp and other such prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0023_000
text:
As it matures, it grows longer. At night, it wraps
its long body around tree branches to rest.

label: ZKN_ZA_0024_000
text:
To intimidate foes, it spreads its chest wide and
makes eerie sounds by expelling air from its
mouth.

label: ZKN_ZA_0025_000
text:
It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks.
When in a tough spot, this Pokémon discharges
electricity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0026_000
text:
When its electricity builds, its muscles are
stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than
usual.

label: ZKN_ZA_0035_000
text:
The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its
back apparently gives it the ability to float in
midair.

label: ZKN_ZA_0036_000
text:
A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will
run and hide the moment it senses people.

label: ZKN_ZA_0039_000
text:
Looking into its cute, round eyes prompts it to
start singing a song so pleasant that listeners
can’t help but fall asleep.

label: ZKN_ZA_0040_000
text:
This Pokémon’s fur feels so nice that if two
Wigglytuff snuggle up against each other, they
can’t bring themselves to separate.

label: ZKN_ZA_0041_000
text:
It sleeps in caves during the day. It has no eyes,
so it emits ultrasonic waves to check its
surroundings while flying.

label: ZKN_ZA_0042_000
text:
Golbat punctures even the hardest of hides with
its sharp fangs, then gorges itself on its victims’
blood.

label: ZKN_ZA_0052_000
text:
It loves anything that shines. It especially adores
coins, which it will pick up and stash somewhere.

label: ZKN_ZA_0053_000
text:
Many admire Persian for the dignity it exudes
from every inch of its body. However, it will lash
out with its claws given the slightest provocation.

label: ZKN_ZA_0056_000
text:
Mankey are perpetually angry. If they spot
suitable prey, they will attack as a group.

label: ZKN_ZA_0057_000
text:
If approached while asleep, it may rouse just
enough to fly into a groggy rage and give chase
without even knowing what it’s doing.

label: ZKN_ZA_0063_000
text:
It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of
extrasensory powers even while asleep.

label: ZKN_ZA_0064_000
text:
If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves
that cause machines to malfunction.

label: ZKN_ZA_0065_000
text:
Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As
a result, it remembers everything.

label: ZKN_ZA_0066_000
text:
Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even
though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl
100 grown-ups.

label: ZKN_ZA_0067_000
text:
It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that
kind of strength, it helps people do heavy jobs.

label: ZKN_ZA_0068_000
text:
It uses its four powerful arms to pin the limbs of
its foe, then throws the victim over the horizon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0069_000
text:
Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is
blindingly fast when catching its prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0070_000
text:
It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the
enemy and then finishes it with a spray of acid.

label: ZKN_ZA_0071_000
text:
Once taken into Victreebel’s body, even the
hardest object will be melted into nothing by
the Pokémon’s acid.

label: ZKN_ZA_0079_000
text:
It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its
tail, it won’t even notice for a whole day.

label: ZKN_ZA_0080_000
text:
An attached Shellder won’t let go because of the
tasty flavor that oozes out of Slowbro’s tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0083_000
text:
The plant stalk it holds is also its beloved weapon.
Farfetch’d can swing the stalk like a katana to cut
all sorts of things.

label: ZKN_ZA_0092_000
text:
It’s born from gases. Anyone would faint if
engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains
poison.

label: ZKN_ZA_0093_000
text:
It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal its
victim’s life force. It lurks in darkness, waiting for
prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0094_000
text:
It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where
Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly
10 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0095_000
text:
It usually lives underground. It searches for food
while boring its way through the ground at
50 mph.

label: ZKN_ZA_0104_000
text:
This Pokémon lost its mother just after its birth.
It wears her skull, never revealing its true face.

label: ZKN_ZA_0105_000
text:
It carries a bone that it collected from someplace
unknown. Rumor has it that somewhere in the
world, there is a graveyard only for Marowak.

label: ZKN_ZA_0115_000
text:
It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its
baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

label: ZKN_ZA_0120_000
text:
Even if its body is torn, it can regenerate as long
as the glowing central core remains intact.

label: ZKN_ZA_0121_000
text:
At the center of its body is a red core that sends
mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

label: ZKN_ZA_0122_000
text:
It uses the mysterious power that emanates from
its fingers to solidify the air around it into
invisible walls.

label: ZKN_ZA_0123_000
text:
It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp
scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

label: ZKN_ZA_0127_000
text:
It swings its long pincers wildly to attack. During
cold periods, it hides deep in forests.

label: ZKN_ZA_0129_000
text:
It is virtually worthless in terms of both power
and speed. It is the weakest and most pathetic
Pokémon in the world.

label: ZKN_ZA_0130_000
text:
In ancient literature, there is a record of a
Gyarados that razed a village when violence
flared.

label: ZKN_ZA_0133_000
text:
Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this
special Pokémon conceals many different
possible evolutions.

label: ZKN_ZA_0134_000
text:
It has evolved to be suited for an aquatic life. It
can become invisible when it melts away into
water.

label: ZKN_ZA_0135_000
text:
It absorbs negative ions from the atmosphere to
spit out 10,000 volts of electricity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0136_000
text:
It has a flame sac inside its body. After inhaling
deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,000
degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0137_000
text:
This is an artificial Pokémon created as a result of
research. Its programming contains only the most
basic of actions.

label: ZKN_ZA_0142_000
text:
It was regenerated from a pterosaur’s genetic
matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-
pitched cries.

label: ZKN_ZA_0147_000
text:
This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually
sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

label: ZKN_ZA_0148_000
text:
Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon
the power to freely control the weather.

label: ZKN_ZA_0149_000
text:
It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea.
It guides wrecked ships to shore.

label: ZKN_ZA_0150_000
text:
It was created by a scientist after years of horrific
gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.

label: ZKN_ZA_0152_000
text:
A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its
head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.

label: ZKN_ZA_0153_000
text:
The spicy aroma emanating from around its neck
has an energizing effect.

label: ZKN_ZA_0154_000
text:
The aroma that rises from its petals contains a
substance that calms aggressive feelings.

label: ZKN_ZA_0158_000
text:
It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate
to take a bite out of anything that moves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0159_000
text:
If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its
place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

label: ZKN_ZA_0160_000
text:
It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding
speed when it attacks and bites prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0167_000
text:
It spins a web using fine yet durable thread. It
then waits patiently for prey to be trapped.

label: ZKN_ZA_0168_000
text:
It spins string not only from its rear but also from
its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

label: ZKN_ZA_0169_000
text:
If it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood,
you won’t notice immediately—its fangs are so
sharp that you won’t feel any pain.

label: ZKN_ZA_0172_000
text:
It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may
send out a jolt if amused or startled.

label: ZKN_ZA_0173_000
text:
According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in
places where shooting stars have fallen.

label: ZKN_ZA_0174_000
text:
It’s always practicing its singing because it wants
to improve. Even when it’s asleep, it keeps
singing in its dreams!

label: ZKN_ZA_0179_000
text:
Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static
electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

label: ZKN_ZA_0180_000
text:
If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity,
its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire wool that zaps on
impact.

label: ZKN_ZA_0181_000
text:
The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from
far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

label: ZKN_ZA_0196_000
text:
It uses the fine fur on its body to sense movement
in the air and predict the weather...as well as its
foes’ thoughts.

label: ZKN_ZA_0197_000
text:
The light of the moon changed Eevee’s genetic
structure. It lurks in the darkness, waiting for
prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0199_000
text:
It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever
the situation, it remains calm and collected.

label: ZKN_ZA_0208_000
text:
It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy
jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness
underground.

label: ZKN_ZA_0211_000
text:
To fire off the poison spikes covering its body, it
inflates itself by sucking in over 2.6 gallons of
water all at once.

label: ZKN_ZA_0212_000
text:
It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by
upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0214_000
text:
This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn
under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws
them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0225_000
text:
It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of
sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

label: ZKN_ZA_0227_000
text:
Because it nests in bramble bushes, the feathers
of its chicks grow hard from being scratched by
thorns.

label: ZKN_ZA_0228_000
text:
Around dawn, their ominous howls echo through
the area to announce their territory.

label: ZKN_ZA_0229_000
text:
The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins.
If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

label: ZKN_ZA_0233_000
text:
Porygon was updated so it could carry out
development projects on other planets. The
update used cutting-edge technology for its time.

label: ZKN_ZA_0246_000
text:
It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large
mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

label: ZKN_ZA_0247_000
text:
Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting
pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

label: ZKN_ZA_0248_000
text:
If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and
buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

label: ZKN_ZA_0252_000
text:
Treecko can quickly scale even vertical surfaces.
It senses humidity with its tails to predict the next
day’s weather.

label: ZKN_ZA_0253_000
text:
Its highly developed thigh muscles provide
explosive bursts of power and incredible leaping
capabilities.

label: ZKN_ZA_0254_000
text:
The leaves that grow on its arms are sharp
enough to fell thick trees by slicing clean through
them. It is without peer in jungle combat.

label: ZKN_ZA_0255_000
text:
Torchic feels very warm to hug because a fire
burns within it. It launches fireballs of over 1,800
degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0256_000
text:
Its kicking mastery lets it unleash 10 kicks per
second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0257_000
text:
It can jump powerfully enough to clear a 30-story
building. It uses flaming punches to incinerate its
opponents.

label: ZKN_ZA_0258_000
text:
Using the fin on its head, Mudkip senses the flow
of water to keep track of what’s going on around
it. It has the strength to heft boulders.

label: ZKN_ZA_0259_000
text:
Its sturdy legs and hips give it sure footing, even
on sludgy surfaces. It buries itself in mud to
sleep.

label: ZKN_ZA_0260_000
text:
This Pokémon is so strong that it can tow a large
ship while it swims. It bashes down foes with a
single swing of its thick arms.

label: ZKN_ZA_0280_000
text:
If its red horns capture the warm feelings of
people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

label: ZKN_ZA_0281_000
text:
The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for
its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances
when happy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0282_000
text:
It has the power to predict the future. Its power
peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

label: ZKN_ZA_0302_000
text:
It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems
has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

label: ZKN_ZA_0303_000
text:
Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed
by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

label: ZKN_ZA_0304_000
text:
When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that
covered its whole body and develops a new one.

label: ZKN_ZA_0305_000
text:
It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory
by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0306_000
text:
It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more
wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t
take it lightly.

label: ZKN_ZA_0307_000
text:
It meditates in order to build up its mental energy.
It eats just one berry a day.

label: ZKN_ZA_0308_000
text:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic
power to predict its foe’s movements.

label: ZKN_ZA_0309_000
text:
It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging.
This Pokémon’s whole body gives off sparks if a
storm approaches.

label: ZKN_ZA_0310_000
text:
It discharges electricity from its mane. The
Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from
which to drop lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_ZA_0315_000
text:
It uses the different poisons in each hand
separately when it attacks. The stronger its
aroma, the healthier it is.

label: ZKN_ZA_0316_000
text:
Its stomach makes up most of its body. Its
powerful gastric juices quickly digest anything it
swallows.

label: ZKN_ZA_0317_000
text:
It swallows anything whole. It douses foes with
the highly toxic fluid it secretes from its follicles.

label: ZKN_ZA_0318_000
text:
They live in massive rivers that course through
jungles. Swarms of these Pokémon attack any
prey that wanders into their territory.

label: ZKN_ZA_0319_000
text:
It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting
seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the
sea.

label: ZKN_ZA_0322_000
text:
The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees
Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses
Fire-type moves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0323_000
text:
The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption
every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really
angry.

label: ZKN_ZA_0325_000
text:
It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring.
The vibrations from this bouncing make its heart
beat.

label: ZKN_ZA_0326_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its black pearls to amplify its
psychic power. It can control the minds of its foes
through its mysterious dancing.

label: ZKN_ZA_0333_000
text:
For some reason, it likes to land on people’s
heads softly and act like it’s a hat.

label: ZKN_ZA_0334_000
text:
It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic
humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.

label: ZKN_ZA_0335_000
text:
Every hair on its body stands up if it so much as
smells a Seviper. Its sharp claws tear foes apart.

label: ZKN_ZA_0336_000
text:
It battles speedy Zangoose using its keenly bladed
tail, which oozes an extremely powerful poison.

label: ZKN_ZA_0349_000
text:
They are famous for their shabby appearance.
Although Feebas are plentiful in number, they
tend to cluster in specific places.

label: ZKN_ZA_0350_000
text:
They dwell at the bottoms of big lakes.
Anyone who beholds the loveliness of these
Pokémon is said to have their heart purified.

label: ZKN_ZA_0352_000
text:
It changes color to blend in with its surroundings
in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its
belly pattern disappear, however.

label: ZKN_ZA_0353_000
text:
It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice—or so
it’s said. It’s very active at night.

label: ZKN_ZA_0354_000
text:
A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and it
became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that
disowned it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0358_000
text:
Chimecho create air vibrations with their cries to
send foes flying. They have seven different types
of cries they use to converse with one another.

label: ZKN_ZA_0359_000
text:
It senses coming disasters and appears before
people only to warn them of impending danger.

label: ZKN_ZA_0361_000
text:
In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a
house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

label: ZKN_ZA_0362_000
text:
To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice,
made by freezing moisture in the air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0371_000
text:
Its well-developed neck muscles and ironlike
head can smash boulders into pieces.

label: ZKN_ZA_0372_000
text:
Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun
changing. The shell peels off the instant the
Pokémon evolves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0373_000
text:
It’s uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around
spouting flames, scorching fields and mountains.

label: ZKN_ZA_0374_000
text:
They communicate with one another by using
magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in
perfect unison.

label: ZKN_ZA_0375_000
text:
It is formed by two Beldum joining together.
Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides
with a jet.

label: ZKN_ZA_0376_000
text:
Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it
has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

label: ZKN_ZA_0380_000
text:
It communicates its feelings using telepathy. To
make itself invisible, it covers its body in down
that refracts light.

label: ZKN_ZA_0381_000
text:
It understands human speech and is highly
intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes
fighting.

label: ZKN_ZA_0382_000
text:
In myths, this Pokémon expanded the seas with
torrential rains and great tsunamis. It battled
ferociously against Groudon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0383_000
text:
Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of
dry land by evaporating water with raging heat.
It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

label: ZKN_ZA_0384_000
text:
Rayquaza cannot be seen from the ground
because it lives in the ozone layer, far above the
clouds.

label: ZKN_ZA_0396_000
text:
They flock in great numbers. Though small, they
flap their wings with great power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0397_000
text:
Their habitats include forests and fields. Territorial
squabbles occur whenever flocks happen to meet.

label: ZKN_ZA_0398_000
text:
The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It
can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0406_000
text:
When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its
bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear
pools.

label: ZKN_ZA_0407_000
text:
It lures prey in with a sweet scent, then finishes
them off with the poisonous whips on its arms—
either by constricting the prey or skewering them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0427_000
text:
One of Buneary’s ears is always rolled up. It can
be forcefully extended to shatter even a large
boulder.

label: ZKN_ZA_0428_000
text:
This Pokémon’s ears are apparently very delicate.
They must be handled gently and with care, or
else Lopunny will kick you with its graceful legs.

label: ZKN_ZA_0433_000
text:
It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its
throat. It gently bounces along from place to
place.

label: ZKN_ZA_0439_000
text:
Mime Jr. is a gifted mimic. When it startles an
opponent with its skills, it feels so delighted that
it forgets to keep up its act.

label: ZKN_ZA_0443_000
text:
It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It
pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

label: ZKN_ZA_0444_000
text:
As it digs to expand its nest, it unearths raw
gemstones. It has a habit of hoarding these in
its nest.

label: ZKN_ZA_0445_000
text:
It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It
never allows its prey to escape.

label: ZKN_ZA_0447_000
text:
The aura that emanates from its body intensifies
to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

label: ZKN_ZA_0448_000
text:
By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how
others are feeling from over half a mile away.

label: ZKN_ZA_0449_000
text:
It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from
germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

label: ZKN_ZA_0450_000
text:
It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its
body to create a towering twister for attack.

label: ZKN_ZA_0459_000
text:
In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of
frozen treats around its belly.

label: ZKN_ZA_0460_000
text:
It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up
blizzards. It is also known as the Ice Monster.

label: ZKN_ZA_0470_000
text:
Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a
result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0471_000
text:
By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the
atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust
flurry.

label: ZKN_ZA_0474_000
text:
Porygon-Z’s programming was updated so that
the Pokémon might operate in other dimensions.
Its behavior has been strikingly odd ever since.

label: ZKN_ZA_0475_000
text:
A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it
fights using the extending swords on its elbows.

label: ZKN_ZA_0478_000
text:
It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly
−60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its
body is actually hollow.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_000
text:
Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to
infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

label: ZKN_ZA_0485_000
text:
Boiling, magma-like blood circulates through its
body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0491_000
text:
It can lull people into a deep sleep and make them
dream. It is active on nights with a new moon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0498_000
text:
It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while
shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries
before it eats them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0499_000
text:
The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the
fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even
more power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0500_000
text:
It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves.
It grows a beard of fire.

label: ZKN_ZA_0504_000
text:
Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can
keep watch for days. They use their tails to
communicate with others.

label: ZKN_ZA_0505_000
text:
Using luminescent matter within its body, it
makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking
opponents.

label: ZKN_ZA_0509_000
text:
Purrloin steals from people for fun, but its
behavior is so charming that its victims can’t
help but forgive it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0510_000
text:
Liepard appear without warning and disappear
just as unexpectedly. Their beautiful physique
and fur charm many Trainers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0511_000
text:
It shares the leaves on its head with weary
Pokémon. These leaves reduce fatigue.

label: ZKN_ZA_0512_000
text:
Ill-tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail
around wildly. The leaves growing on its head are
very bitter.

label: ZKN_ZA_0513_000
text:
Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating
them. It likes to help people.

label: ZKN_ZA_0514_000
text:
When it gets excited, embers rise from its head
and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves
sweets.

label: ZKN_ZA_0515_000
text:
The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full
of nutrients. It provides this water to plants by
using its tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0516_000
text:
It prefers places with clean water. When the
stores of water on its head run low, it replenishes
its supply by siphoning up more with its tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0517_000
text:
It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When
it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored
mist.

label: ZKN_ZA_0518_000
text:
The mist from its forehead takes the shape of
things that appeared in dreams Musharna has
eaten, giving those dreams physical form.

label: ZKN_ZA_0529_000
text:
By spinning its body, it can dig straight through
the ground at a speed of 30 mph.

label: ZKN_ZA_0530_000
text:
More than 300 feet below the surface, they build
mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to
subway tunnels.

label: ZKN_ZA_0531_000
text:
It touches others with the feelers on its ears,
using the sound of their heartbeats to check their
emotions and physical health.

label: ZKN_ZA_0538_000
text:
They train strenuously in groups of five. Any
member that can’t keep up will discard its belt
and leave the group.

label: ZKN_ZA_0539_000
text:
Tightening their belts gets them pumped and
makes their punches more destructive. Disturb
their training and you’ll earn their wrath.

label: ZKN_ZA_0543_000
text:
Its bite injects a venom potent enough to paralyze
even the large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0544_000
text:
Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a
wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0545_000
text:
It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until
they stop moving. Then it finishes them off with
deadly venom.

label: ZKN_ZA_0551_000
text:
It moves below the sand’s surface, exposing only
its nose and eyes. A black membrane shields its
eyes from the sun.

label: ZKN_ZA_0552_000
text:
The special membrane covering its eyes can sense
the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings
even in darkness.

label: ZKN_ZA_0553_000
text:
They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so
powerful, they can tear apart the body of an
automobile.

label: ZKN_ZA_0559_000
text:
Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce
damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its
neck.

label: ZKN_ZA_0560_000
text:
It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it
kicks. The bigger the crest, the more arrogantly
it behaves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0562_000
text:
Each Yamask carries a mask representing the face
it had when it was still human. Sometimes it
gazes at the mask and weeps.

label: ZKN_ZA_0563_000
text:
Grave robbers sometimes mistake this Pokémon
for a real coffin and get too close to it. They end
up trapped within Cofagrigus’s body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0568_000
text:
The combination of garbage bags and industrial
waste caused the chemical reaction that created
this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0569_000
text:
Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison
gases and liquids inside their bodies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0582_000
text:
The temperature of their breath is −58 degrees
Fahrenheit. They create snow crystals and make
snow fall in the areas around them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0583_000
text:
They cool down the surrounding air and create ice
particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0584_000
text:
If both heads get angry simultaneously, this
Pokémon expels a blizzard from its horn, burying
everything in snow.

label: ZKN_ZA_0587_000
text:
The energy made in its cheeks’ electric pouches is
stored inside its patagial membranes and released
while it is gliding.

label: ZKN_ZA_0590_000
text:
It lures targets in with its Poké Ball–like pattern
and sprays poison spores at them. Why it
resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

label: ZKN_ZA_0591_000
text:
They show off their Poké Ball caps in an attempt
to lure prey close, but few Pokémon are fooled.

label: ZKN_ZA_0602_000
text:
One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so
a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful
electric shock.

label: ZKN_ZA_0603_000
text:
It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes them
with electricity from the round spots on its sides.
Then it chomps.

label: ZKN_ZA_0604_000
text:
With their sucker mouths, they latch on to prey.
Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with
electricity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0607_000
text:
Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy
of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel
that it burns.

label: ZKN_ZA_0608_000
text:
Lampent appears at the moment of death and
promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0609_000
text:
Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up
the spirit, leaving the body behind.

label: ZKN_ZA_0615_000
text:
Cryogonal use chains made of ice crystals to
ensnare prey. They freeze their victims at −148
degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0618_000
text:
It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then
it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of
electricity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0622_000
text:
Ancient people apparently fashioned Golett out of
clay to do their labor for them. What powers these
Pokémon remains unclear.

label: ZKN_ZA_0623_000
text:
It’s said that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion
machine that produces energy, but the truth is
not yet known.

label: ZKN_ZA_0638_000
text:
It has a body and heart of steel. One glare from
Cobalion can bring even the most ferocious of
Pokémon to heel.

label: ZKN_ZA_0639_000
text:
It charges with enough force to break through a
giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon
is spoken of in legends.

label: ZKN_ZA_0640_000
text:
It confounds opponents with its quick movement,
darting around them like a whirlwind as it carves
them up mercilessly with its sharp horns.

label: ZKN_ZA_0647_000
text:
By shooting water from its hooves, Keldeo can
travel across the water’s surface as if skating. It’s
skilled at using kicking moves in battle.

label: ZKN_ZA_0648_000
text:
Sung using a special vocalization technique,
Meloetta’s songs can manipulate the emotions
of those who hear them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0649_000
text:
This bug Pokémon of the Paleozoic era was
revived by a certain organization, which also
upgraded the cannon on Genesect’s back.

label: ZKN_ZA_0650_000
text:
The quills on its head are usually soft. When it
flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp
that they can pierce rock.

label: ZKN_ZA_0651_000
text:
They strengthen their lower bodies by running
into one another. They are very kind and won’t
start fights.

label: ZKN_ZA_0652_000
text:
Its tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank.
It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0653_000
text:
Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy
ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees
Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0654_000
text:
It keeps a twig in its tail. Using friction from its
tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into
battle.

label: ZKN_ZA_0655_000
text:
Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of
5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept
into this whirl of flame.

label: ZKN_ZA_0656_000
text:
It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate
bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps
a watchful eye on its surroundings.

label: ZKN_ZA_0657_000
text:
Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower
of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

label: ZKN_ZA_0658_000
text:
It creates throwing stars out of compressed
water. When it spins them and throws them at
high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

label: ZKN_ZA_0659_000
text:
They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will
dig the whole night through without rest.

label: ZKN_ZA_0660_000
text:
With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders
of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help
at construction sites.

label: ZKN_ZA_0661_000
text:
Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it’s
merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

label: ZKN_ZA_0662_000
text:
The hotter the flame sac in its belly, the faster it
can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire
going.

label: ZKN_ZA_0663_000
text:
In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers
embers from the gaps between its feathers as it
flies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0664_000
text:
The powder that covers its body regulates its
temperature, so it can live in any region or
climate.

label: ZKN_ZA_0665_000
text:
It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When
predators attack, it bristles the fur covering its
body in an effort to threaten them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0666_000
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born in.
This form is from frigid lands.

label: ZKN_ZA_0667_000
text:
They set off on their own from their pride and live
by themselves to become stronger. These hot-
blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

label: ZKN_ZA_0668_000
text:
The male with the largest mane of fire is the
leader of the pride.

label: ZKN_ZA_0669_000
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden
within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly
fond of red flowers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_000
text:
This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to
pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth
their latent potential.

label: ZKN_ZA_0671_000
text:
They say that flower gardens created by Florges
constantly emit a power that can heal both body
and spirit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0672_000
text:
If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to
eat, because it can generate energy from the
leaves on its back.

label: ZKN_ZA_0673_000
text:
It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts
in their grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets
human and Pokémon run as if one being.

label: ZKN_ZA_0674_000
text:
It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face,
but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.

label: ZKN_ZA_0675_000
text:
Although it has a violent temperament, it won’t
put up with those who bully the weak. It senses
foes’ movements with its leaf.

label: ZKN_ZA_0676_000
text:
Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokémon
were the designated guardians of the king.

label: ZKN_ZA_0677_000
text:
It keeps its intense psychic power from leaking
out by using its ears to cover the organs emitting
that power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0678_000
text:
When in danger, it raises its ears and releases
enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck
into dust.

label: ZKN_ZA_0679_000
text:
Apparently Honedge was born when a departed
spirit began inhabiting an ancient sword. It
attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

label: ZKN_ZA_0680_000
text:
When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords
that cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks
and slash their enemies to ribbons.

label: ZKN_ZA_0681_000
text:
Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of
leadership. According to legend, whoever it
recognizes is destined to rule.

label: ZKN_ZA_0682_000
text:
In the past, rather than using perfume, royal
ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a
fragrance they liked.

label: ZKN_ZA_0683_000
text:
Its scent is so overpowering that, unless they
happen to really enjoy the smell, Trainers will
have a hard time walking alongside it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0684_000
text:
To entangle and immobilize its opponents in
battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and
sticky as cotton candy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0685_000
text:
It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its
sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry
chefs in their work.

label: ZKN_ZA_0686_000
text:
It drains foes’ will to fight by flashing light at
them. It then takes the opportunity to hide itself
away.

label: ZKN_ZA_0687_000
text:
It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of
any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever
it wants.

label: ZKN_ZA_0688_000
text:
Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they
fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

label: ZKN_ZA_0689_000
text:
Barbaracle’s legs and hands have minds of
their own, and they will move independently.
But they usually follow the head’s orders.

label: ZKN_ZA_0690_000
text:
Camouflaged as rotten kelp, this Pokémon sprays
liquid poison to take down prey that approach
unawares.

label: ZKN_ZA_0691_000
text:
Their poison is strong enough to eat through the
hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at
anything that enters their territory.

label: ZKN_ZA_0692_000
text:
They knock down flying prey by firing compressed
water from their massive claws like shooting a
pistol.

label: ZKN_ZA_0693_000
text:
By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of
its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

label: ZKN_ZA_0694_000
text:
The frills on either side of its head have cells that
generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.

label: ZKN_ZA_0695_000
text:
They flare their frills and generate energy. A single
Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to
power a skyscraper.

label: ZKN_ZA_0696_000
text:
This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If
something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws
a tantrum and runs wild.

label: ZKN_ZA_0697_000
text:
This Pokémon behaved like a king 100 million
years ago. Nothing could stop it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0698_000
text:
This ancient Pokémon was restored from a part of
its body that had been frozen in ice for 100 million
years.

label: ZKN_ZA_0699_000
text:
The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air
as cold as −240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding
its enemies and encasing them in ice.

label: ZKN_ZA_0700_000
text:
It wraps its ribbonlike feelers around the arm of
its beloved Trainer and walks with them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0701_000
text:
With its wings, it controls its position in the air.
It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is
difficult to defend against.

label: ZKN_ZA_0702_000
text:
Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and
receiving electrical waves, it can communicate
with others over vast distances.

label: ZKN_ZA_0703_000
text:
Born from the high temperatures and pressures
deep underground, it releases energy from the
stone in its head.

label: ZKN_ZA_0704_000
text:
Thanks to the slimy membrane covering its body,
punches or kicks from its enemies slide right
off it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0705_000
text:
Its four horns are a high-performance radar
system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells,
rather than using ears or a nose.

label: ZKN_ZA_0706_000
text:
This very friendly dragon Pokémon will hug its
beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in
sticky slime.

label: ZKN_ZA_0707_000
text:
It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give
it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent
crime.

label: ZKN_ZA_0708_000
text:
According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps
possessed by the spirits of children who died
while lost in the forest.

label: ZKN_ZA_0709_000
text:
Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls
the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon
that reside in its body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0710_000
text:
It was recently discovered that the different
varieties of Pumpkaboo vary not only in size but
also in the size of the souls they collect.

label: ZKN_ZA_0711_000
text:
Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets
on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears
their song is cursed.

label: ZKN_ZA_0712_000
text:
It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that
shields its body. If the ice breaks, this Pokémon
uses cold air to quickly create new ice.

label: ZKN_ZA_0713_000
text:
Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its
enormous frame crushes anything that stands in
its way.

label: ZKN_ZA_0714_000
text:
Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and
unable to stand when exposed to its
200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0715_000
text:
They fly around on moonless nights and attack
careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle
in the dark.

label: ZKN_ZA_0716_000
text:
When the horns on its head shine in seven colors,
it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

label: ZKN_ZA_0717_000
text:
It’s said that when its life comes to an end, it
absorbs the life energy of every living thing and
turns into a cocoon once more.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_000
text:
It’s hypothesized that it’s monitoring those who
destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave
where it lives.

label: ZKN_ZA_0719_000
text:
Diancie is a spontaneous mutation of Carbink. Its
pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest
sight in the whole world.

label: ZKN_ZA_0720_000
text:
It uses loops to gather things it likes and take
them to its secret home. It also teleports through
a loop.

label: ZKN_ZA_0721_000
text:
It expels its internal steam from the arms
on its back. It has enough power to blow
away a mountain.

label: ZKN_ZA_0739_000
text:
Its hard pincers are well-suited to both offense
and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are
like boxing matches.

label: ZKN_ZA_0740_000
text:
It punches things without pausing to think. There
are even records of Crabominable forcing back an
avalanche with a flurry of punches.

label: ZKN_ZA_0767_000
text:
Its habitat includes everything from beaches to
seabeds. It is happy to eat up even rotten scraps,
providing a sort of natural cleaning service.

label: ZKN_ZA_0768_000
text:
It has the skill to cleave even air or seawater in
two with a flash of its giant, sharp claws.

label: ZKN_ZA_0769_000
text:
Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of
sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond
of the shovel on its head.

label: ZKN_ZA_0770_000
text:
Heaps of bones lie buried beneath its castle. They
came from those whom Palossand drained of
vitality and left all dried up.

label: ZKN_ZA_0778_000
text:
A lonely Pokémon, it conceals its terrifying
appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer
to people and other Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0780_000
text:
It has a compassionate personality, but if it is
angered, it completely destroys its surroundings
with its intense breath.

label: ZKN_ZA_0801_000
text:
This Pokémon was built by a scientist roughly
500 years ago. The part called the Soul-Heart is
the actual life-form.

label: ZKN_ZA_0802_000
text:
It slips into others’ shadows and mimics their
movements and powers. With time, its prowess
will surpass that of those it originally imitated.

label: ZKN_ZA_0807_000
text:
Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs.
Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and
thunder echoes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0808_000
text:
Its body is made up of molten steel. It melts
particles of iron and other metals it finds in the
ground and absorbs them into itself.

label: ZKN_ZA_0809_000
text:
It was worshipped long ago for its capacity to
produce iron. For some reason, it has come back
to life after 3,000 years.

label: ZKN_ZA_0821_000
text:
This valiant Pokémon will challenge any foe, no
matter how mighty. Even if that backfires and
Rookidee loses, it grows from the experience.

label: ZKN_ZA_0822_000
text:
Corvisquire are intelligent enough to use tools.
They’ll use their feet to pick up and fling pebbles
or wrap their enemies in ropes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0823_000
text:
Its wings, now made of steel, are extremely
tough. Even if it’s attacked mid-flight, Corviknight
flies on mightily through the sky, unbothered.

label: ZKN_ZA_0827_000
text:
It filches food from people and Pokémon alike.
While fleeing the scene, it wipes its tracks away
with its tail to throw off pursuers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0828_000
text:
This clever Pokémon marks potential targets with
its scent, then follows its nose to locate their
nests.

label: ZKN_ZA_0848_000
text:
It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison
to produce electricity. The wattage is weak, but it
can cause a tingling numbness.

label: ZKN_ZA_0849_000
text:
When Toxtricity claws at the protrusions on its
chest to generate electricity, a sound like that of a
guitar echoes through the air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0852_000
text:
The bulbous ends of its tentacles are perfect for
pummeling but next to useless for gripping.

label: ZKN_ZA_0853_000
text:
Grapploct pins opponents to the ground with its
prized tentacles. Not even monstrously strong
Pokémon can wrestle free from its hold.

label: ZKN_ZA_0863_000
text:
In battle, Perrserker boasts unrivaled strength,
and many epic sagas tell of its valor. But in its
home, it leaves garbage everywhere.

label: ZKN_ZA_0865_000
text:
Sirfetch’d has put its soul into nurturing its leek,
which it treasures like life itself. It wields the leek
splendidly, performing great feats of combat.

label: ZKN_ZA_0866_000
text:
Its comical dancing is its calling card. When its
enemies laugh, it seizes the chance to blast them
with frigid air of −328 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0867_000
text:
The scattered pieces of its clay slab have been
reassembled, allowing the malicious power
contained within to be fully unleashed.

label: ZKN_ZA_0870_000
text:
Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass.
The brass’s orders are absolute.

label: ZKN_ZA_0876_000
text:
Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions
of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the
source of its strength.

label: ZKN_ZA_0877_000
text:
This Pokémon is always hungry. It generates
electricity by eating seeds it has stored up in its
pocket-like pouches.

label: ZKN_ZA_0900_000
text:
Its stone axes get chipped away here and there
during ferocious battles, but the process serves
to make them sharper and sharper.

label: ZKN_ZA_0904_000
text:
Overqwil’s poisonous spikes—now thicker, longer,
and stronger—will automatically strike toward
anything that moves.

label: ZKN_ZA_0971_000
text:
This Pokémon loves to gambol and roughhouse.
It rubs its fur up against others and absorbs their
life force until they’re utterly drained.

label: ZKN_ZA_0972_000
text:
At some point during the many years it spent
guarding the gravestone of its dearly departed
master, it was reborn as a ghost Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0977_000
text:
Although it boasts fantastic strength and a huge
body that stirs up great waves when it thrashes,
Dondozo struggles at catching prey.

label: ZKN_ZA_0951_000
text:
Capsakid is prone to intense mood swings,
perhaps influenced by the spicy chemicals inside
it. It will bite anything it takes a disliking to.

label: ZKN_ZA_0952_000
text:
Its two heads have different temperaments and
excel at different fighting styles. Nevertheless,
they act in perfect harmony on the battlefield.

label: ZKN_ZA_0996_000
text:
Frigibax’s dorsal fin can convert heat from fiery
moves into Ice-type energy to freeze the air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0997_000
text:
Arctibax is armed with a bladed dorsal fin and a
mask made of ice. It is agile in its movements,
springing upon foes to deliver slashing attacks.

label: ZKN_ZA_0998_000
text:
Baxcalibur exhales air cold enough to freeze lava.
It uses its breath to freeze foes, then pulverizes
them with a blow from its tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_000
text:
Tatsugiri will battle furiously among themselves
to determine which of them will get to partner
with a particular Dondozo.

label: ZKN_ZA_0967_000
text:
Cyclizar keeps energy stored in the folds of its
throat, allowing it to run nonstop over very long
distances while carrying someone.

label: ZKN_ZA_0931_000
text:
Squawkabilly form flocks based on the color of
their plumage. Green ones are abundant because
their coloration is more likely to be passed down.

label: ZKN_ZA_0973_000
text:
A flock of Flamigo can reach numbers of over
10,000. The sight of one of these massive flocks
moving together in sync is incredible to behold.

label: ZKN_ZA_0932_000
text:
As Nacli treads along the ground, grains of rock
salt are left behind. These trails have been called
“salt roads” since long ago.

label: ZKN_ZA_0933_000
text:
This absent-minded Pokémon tends to forget
about the prey it has salt-cured. It’s even prone to
forgetting the orders its Trainer has given it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0934_000
text:
Rock salt obtained from Garganacl has many
restorative elements and is helpful for
maintaining one’s health.

label: ZKN_ZA_0969_000
text:
Glimmet clings to the ceilings of caves. It defends
itself by striking enemies with its bud, which is
packed with poisonous components.

label: ZKN_ZA_0970_000
text:
Glimmora blooms into a large flower made of
poisonous components. It works together with
groups of Glimmet to repel enemies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0944_000
text:
Shroodle protects itself from foes using both its
poisonous saliva and its front teeth, which are
disproportionately big and long for its small body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0945_000
text:
What Grafaiai eats affects the color of its saliva.
With this saliva, it paints patterns on rocks and
trees in order to protect its territory.

label: ZKN_ZA_0926_000
text:
This Pokémon cultivates yeast within its body. It
has lived with humans—and helped enrich their
diets—since ancient times.

label: ZKN_ZA_0927_000
text:
The appetizing scent of Dachsbun’s body sends
opponents’ hunger into overdrive, wearing down
their willpower and stamina.

label: ZKN_ZA_0942_000
text:
Packs of these Pokémon are incredibly close-knit.
In order to be taken seriously, Maschiff intimidate
others by wearing a grumpy expression.

label: ZKN_ZA_0943_000
text:
Contrary to appearances, Mabosstiff has a kind
heart—but it will relentlessly chase down and put
an end to any foe that dares threaten its family.

label: ZKN_ZA_0999_000
text:
It lurks inside a sturdy treasure chest and
possesses solid defenses, but it’s so heavy that it
has difficulty moving around.

label: ZKN_ZA_1000_000
text:
This Pokémon likes lively places. Some wild
Gholdengo even live in cities.

label: ZKN_ZA_0957_000
text:
Tinkatink cobbles together a suitable hammer for
itself using tools and metal fragments it finds in
mines.

label: ZKN_ZA_0958_000
text:
Tinkatuff sometimes come to human settlements,
where they rummage through factories and
warehouses to gather metal.

label: ZKN_ZA_0959_000
text:
A Tinkaton leader teaches the Tinkatink in its
group the skills needed for pounding and shaping
metal.

label: ZKN_ZA_0935_000
text:
This Pokémon is skilled at manipulating flames.
Humans have prized it highly since ancient times.

label: ZKN_ZA_0936_000
text:
Though Armarouge pledges loyalty to its Trainer,
it repeatedly leaves to go train on its own to
strengthen its psychic energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0937_000
text:
It swears loyalty to its Trainer. Should anyone
dare to show that Trainer hostility, Ceruledge will
cut the offender down without a second thought.

label: ZKN_ZA_0979_000
text:
Primeape evolved into Annihilape after repeatedly
using a move with enough force to burst the
blood vessels in its head.

label: ZKN_ZA_0003_001
text:
In order to support its flower, which has grown
larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs
have become stronger.

label: ZKN_ZA_0006_001
text:
The overwhelming power that fills its entire body
causes it to turn black and creates intense blue
flames.

label: ZKN_ZA_0006_002
text:
Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power.
It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than
that of a jet.

label: ZKN_ZA_0009_001
text:
The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank
gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to
withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0015_001
text:
Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its
prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs,
dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

label: ZKN_ZA_0018_001
text:
With its muscular strength now greatly increased,
it can fly continuously for two weeks without
resting.

label: ZKN_ZA_0026_001
text:
It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops
aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift
the tail and move about while riding it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0026_002
text:
It resembles an X as it flies through the air with
50 million volts of electricity sparking from its
ears and forked tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0026_003
text:
It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail
and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its
temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.

label: ZKN_ZA_0036_001
text:
It flies by using the power of moonlight to control
gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0052_001
text:
It’s fickle, selfish, and easily bored. This species is
very popular with certain Trainers—ones who
prefer fulfilling others’ needs over their own.

label: ZKN_ZA_0052_002
text:
Its unkempt beard is a vestige from living in cold
climes. It fights dauntlessly using its steel claws.

label: ZKN_ZA_0053_001
text:
Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that
have bigger, plumper faces are considered more
beautiful.

label: ZKN_ZA_0065_001
text:
Alakazam has traded away its muscles,
unleashing its true power. With its psychic
powers, it can foresee all things.

label: ZKN_ZA_0071_001
text:
The volume of this Pokémon’s acid has increased
due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it’s
not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.

label: ZKN_ZA_0079_001
text:
Although this Pokémon is normally zoned out, its
expression abruptly sharpens on occasion. The
cause for this seems to lie in Slowpoke’s diet.

label: ZKN_ZA_0080_001
text:
When bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution,
Shellder converts into impregnable armor. There
is virtually no change in Slowpoke.

label: ZKN_ZA_0080_002
text:
A Shellder bite set off a chemical reaction with
the spices inside Slowbro’s body, causing
Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0083_001
text:
Wielding a thick, heavy leek has strengthened its
body. In battle, it bets everything on a single
destructive blow.

label: ZKN_ZA_0094_001
text:
It can pass through other dimensions and appear
anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck
just one leg out of a wall.

label: ZKN_ZA_0105_001
text:
It has transformed the spirit of its dear departed
mother into flames, and tonight it will once again
dance in mourning of others of its kind.

label: ZKN_ZA_0115_001
text:
Its child has grown rapidly, thanks to the
energy of Mega Evolution. Mother and child
show off their harmonious teamwork in battle.

label: ZKN_ZA_0121_001
text:
Its movements have become more humanlike.
Whether it’s simply trying to communicate or
wants to supplant humanity is unclear.

label: ZKN_ZA_0122_001
text:
It uses its tap-dancing steps to rapidly chill the
surrounding area and form a splendid stage made
of ice.

label: ZKN_ZA_0127_001
text:
After Mega Evolution, it becomes able to fly.
Perhaps because it’s so happy, it rarely touches
the ground.

label: ZKN_ZA_0130_001
text:
It jets water from the orifices on its sides,
streaking above the water surface at supersonic
speed.

label: ZKN_ZA_0142_001
text:
Parts of its body have become stone. Some
scholars claim that this is Aerodactyl’s true
appearance.

label: ZKN_ZA_0149_001
text:
Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this
Pokémon’s feelings of kindness. It finishes off its
opponents with mercy in its heart.

label: ZKN_ZA_0150_001
text:
Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has
a grip strength of one ton and can sprint 100
meters in two seconds flat!

label: ZKN_ZA_0150_002
text:
Despite its diminished size, its mental power has
grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can
smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

label: ZKN_ZA_0154_001
text:
This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful
Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name
for this is Mega Sol Cannon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0160_001
text:
With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon
forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times
as powerful as Mega Feraligatr’s actual jaws.

label: ZKN_ZA_0181_001
text:
Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated
Ampharos’s cells, apparently awakening its long-
sleeping dragon’s blood.

label: ZKN_ZA_0199_001
text:
A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving
has increased Shellder’s intelligence to the point
that Shellder now controls Slowking.

label: ZKN_ZA_0208_001
text:
To protect itself from opponents’ attacks, it uses
magnetism to control pieces of its hard outer
shell that have flaked off.

label: ZKN_ZA_0211_001
text:
This Pokémon eats toxic minerals to build up
poison within itself. Get jabbed by it, and you’ll
face three days and three nights of misery.

label: ZKN_ZA_0212_001
text:
Due to the effects of Mega Evolution, its pincers
have taken on a more diabolical form, ripping
anything they pinch to shreds.

label: ZKN_ZA_0214_001
text:
It can grip things with its two horns and
lift 500 times its own body weight.

label: ZKN_ZA_0227_001
text:
It flies faster than the speed of sound. After
whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying,
it finishes them off with its talons.

label: ZKN_ZA_0229_001
text:
Houndoom’s entire body generates heat when it
Mega Evolves. Its intense, fiery breath turns its
opponents to charcoal.

label: ZKN_ZA_0248_001
text:
The effects of Mega Evolution make it more
ferocious than ever. It’s unclear whether it can
even hear its Trainer’s orders.

label: ZKN_ZA_0254_001
text:
The seeds on its back are filled with energy from
Mega Evolution. The Pokémon detonates these
seeds to launch the tip of its tail.

label: ZKN_ZA_0257_001
text:
Boiling-hot blood courses through its entire body,
doubling the sharpness of its moves. It subdues
opponents in the blink of an eye.

label: ZKN_ZA_0260_001
text:
The water within its body further strengthens its
already enlarged muscles, using the same
principles as a hydraulic pump.

label: ZKN_ZA_0282_001
text:
When it opens the red plate on its chest and
unleashes its heart, its strongest psychic power
is released.

label: ZKN_ZA_0302_001
text:
The jewel from its chest, which has grown
gigantic due to the effects of Mega Evolution, can
turn back any attack.

label: ZKN_ZA_0303_001
text:
Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if
they each had a will of their own. One gnash from
them can turn a boulder to dust.

label: ZKN_ZA_0306_001
text:
Energy from Mega Evolution has turned the
iron inside this Pokémon into steel armor
that covers Mega Aggron’s whole body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0308_001
text:
Thanks to Mega Evolution, its mental power is
limitless. It conjures up arms imbued with malice
to defeat its enemies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0310_001
text:
Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous
amount of electricity, but it’s too much for
Manectric to fully control.

label: ZKN_ZA_0319_001
text:
The spines sprouting from its head are
transformed fangs. If they’re injured or broken off,
the spines will regenerate countless times.

label: ZKN_ZA_0323_001
text:
When this Pokémon’s rage reaches a boiling
point, the huge volcano in the hump on its back
erupts violently, spewing molten lava.

label: ZKN_ZA_0334_001
text:
Its down is so soft, it seems as if a touch could
melt it. But it’s strong enough that just a few
strands could be used to hoist a dump truck.

label: ZKN_ZA_0354_001
text:
Mega Evolution increases its vindictiveness, and
the cursing power that was held back by its zipper
comes spilling out.

label: ZKN_ZA_0358_001
text:
It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions
using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations
get so confused, they forget who they are.

label: ZKN_ZA_0359_001
text:
When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its
back as though beating its wings, it sends an
intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

label: ZKN_ZA_0359_002
text:
Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike
shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This
is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.

label: ZKN_ZA_0362_001
text:
When it spews stupendously cold air from its
broken mouth, the entire area around it gets
whited out.

label: ZKN_ZA_0373_001
text:
To streamline itself for flight, it pulls its forelegs
into its shell. Salamence flies at high speeds even
when faced with complex topographical features.

label: ZKN_ZA_0376_001
text:
This form results from one Metagross, one
Metang, and two Beldum linking up.

label: ZKN_ZA_0380_001
text:
Both its flying capabilities and its attack power
have increased. It scatters transparent down to
confuse its enemies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0381_001
text:
It flies at speeds exceeding Mach 4. It is among
the top tier of all Pokémon in terms of aerial
combat capability.

label: ZKN_ZA_0382_001
text:
Kyogre reverted to this state via the Blue Orb,
which contains the energy of the primordial
world. Kyogre’s body resembles seawater.

label: ZKN_ZA_0383_001
text:
This is Groudon’s true form, restored using the
Red Orb. Energy spills from its body in the form
of magma.

label: ZKN_ZA_0384_001
text:
A shooting star streaking across the night sky
may, in fact, be Mega Rayquaza flying gracefully
after a meteoroid.

label: ZKN_ZA_0398_001
text:
Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily
soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that
weighs more than 880 lbs.

label: ZKN_ZA_0428_001
text:
It swings its ears like whips and strikes its
enemies with them. It has an intensely combative
disposition.

label: ZKN_ZA_0445_001
text:
Its disposition is more vicious than before its
Mega Evolution. Garchomp carves its opponents
up with the scythes on both arms.

label: ZKN_ZA_0445_002
text:
Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form.
It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them
to shreds with its sinister wing claws.

label: ZKN_ZA_0448_001
text:
Black streaks all over its body show where its
auras and the energy of Mega Evolution
intermingled and raced through it.

label: ZKN_ZA_0448_002
text:
By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega
Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling
as if it were gracefully dancing.

label: ZKN_ZA_0460_001
text:
The buds on its back have sprouted into
impressive icicles that can whip up massive
blizzards of −22 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_ZA_0475_001
text:
It gets power from the bond it has with its Trainer.
Mega Evolution has given it plates to slice its
enemies and a cape to protect its body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0478_001
text:
This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with
ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things,
such as flames or the wind.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_001
text:
This Rotom has possessed a convection
microwave oven that uses a special motor. It has a
flair for manipulating flames.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_002
text:
This Rotom has possessed a washing machine
that uses a special motor. It blasts out water to
intimidate opponents.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_003
text:
This Rotom has possessed a refrigerator that uses
a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_004
text:
This Rotom has possessed an electric fan that
uses a special motor. It sends its enemies flying
with gusts of wind.

label: ZKN_ZA_0479_005
text:
This Rotom has possessed a lawn mower that
uses a special motor. As it mows down grass, it
scatters the clippings everywhere.

label: ZKN_ZA_0485_001
text:
It’s said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body
up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees
Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.

label: ZKN_ZA_0491_001
text:
Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the
surrounding area into darkness. There is no
escaping its evil eye.

label: ZKN_ZA_0500_001
text:
Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a
serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its
imperiled allies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0530_001
text:
If this Pokémon brings its arms and head
together to form a streamlined shape and spins
at high speeds, it can destroy anything.

label: ZKN_ZA_0531_001
text:
Anyone who touches the secondary feelers that
have sprouted from the base of its throat will fall
into a deep sleep.

label: ZKN_ZA_0545_001
text:
Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom
affects Scolipede’s mind, honing its viciousness.

label: ZKN_ZA_0560_001
text:
Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty’s shed skin to
turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course,
this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.

label: ZKN_ZA_0562_001
text:
A cursed clay slab and a departed spirit have
become bound together. This Pokémon swings its
slab around with malicious intent.

label: ZKN_ZA_0604_001
text:
It now generates 10 times the electricity it did
before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity
from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.

label: ZKN_ZA_0609_001
text:
One of its eyes is a window linking our world with
the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and
converts it into power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0618_001
text:
Living in mud with a high iron content has given
it a strong steel body.

label: ZKN_ZA_0623_001
text:
The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by
Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at
any moment.

label: ZKN_ZA_0647_001
text:
Keldeo’s magnificent horn is proof of its resolve.
Its allies provided guidance, and their hopes
became Keldeo’s tricolored plume of feathers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0648_001
text:
Now that it has reclaimed a long-forgotten song,
Meloetta captivates everyone with its enchanting
dance steps.

label: ZKN_ZA_0649_001
text:
Genesect assumes its flight configuration to soar
through the sky. Its current form is equipped with
a cassette loaded with water energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0649_002
text:
Genesect fires off projectile energy blasts. Its
current form is equipped with a cassette loaded
with electric energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0649_003
text:
Genesect possesses sharp steel claws. Its
current form is equipped with a cassette
loaded with fire energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0649_004
text:
Genesect is devoid of mercy. Its current form is
equipped with a cassette loaded with ice energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0652_001
text:
It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all
costs. Both are absurdly strong.

label: ZKN_ZA_0655_001
text:
It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents
before incinerating them with a huge fireball.

label: ZKN_ZA_0658_001
text:
It creates throwing stars out of compressed
water. When it spins them and throws them at
high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

label: ZKN_ZA_0658_003
text:
This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high
speed to make it float, then clings to it upside
down to catch opponents unawares.

blazing mane as it protects its allies.

label: ZKN_ZA_0669_001
text:
This Flabébé rides a yellow flower. The Pokémon
is defenseless and vulnerable before it has found
and received power from a flower.

label: ZKN_ZA_0669_002
text:
It receives strength from flowers and gives them
some of its energy in return. This Pokémon likes
orange flowers best of all.

label: ZKN_ZA_0669_003
text:
This Pokémon likes blue flowers best of all. It
floats upward using the power emanating from its
flower and bobs along lightly through the air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0669_004
text:
When evening falls, it searches out a place
blooming with flowers of the same white color as
its own flower, and then it goes to sleep.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_001
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden
within yellow flowers. This power then becomes
the moves Floette uses to protect itself.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_002
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the most power
when in sync with orange flowers, compared to
flowers of other colors.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_003
text:
Whenever this Pokémon finds flowering plants
that are withering, it will bring them back to its
territory and care for them until they are healthy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_004
text:
If it finds someone messing up a flower bed, it
will attack them without mercy. This Floette takes
particularly good care of white flowers.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_005
text:
This rare Floette holds a plant that died out in
ancient times. The Pokémon is said to harbor an
incredible power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0670_006
text:

from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks
enemies on its own.

label: ZKN_ZA_0671_001

protected the garden of a castle for over 300

label: ZKN_ZA_0671_002

powerful beams as if they were a battery of
artillery.

label: ZKN_ZA_0671_003

Blue pigments were tremendously expensive in
the past, so paintings of blue Florges are highly
valuable.

label: ZKN_ZA_0671_004
text:
A flower garden made by a white-flowered Florges
will be beautifully decorated with flowering plants
of many different colors.

Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive

label: ZKN_ZA_0678_002
text:
Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to
compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes
by contorting space itself.

label: ZKN_ZA_0681_001
text:
This stance is dedicated to offense. It can cleave
any opponent with the strength and weight of its
steel blade.

label: ZKN_ZA_0687_001
text:
It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the
personalities and memories of others—and to
control them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0689_001
text:
It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents.
This keeps the head extremely busy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0691_001
text:
It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power
of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to
everything other than itself.

label: ZKN_ZA_0701_001
text:
Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles.
Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.

label: ZKN_ZA_0705_001
text:
The iron in Sliggoo’s drinking water turned its
shell metallic. The Pokémon doesn’t come out of
its shell on sunny days.

label: ZKN_ZA_0706_001
text:
If anything bad happens to it, Goodra retreats into
its shell and bounces around like a rubber ball,
knocking down trees and boring into mountains.

label: ZKN_ZA_0710_001
text:
In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of
Pumpkaboo takes the small spirits of children to
the afterlife.

label: ZKN_ZA_0710_002
text:
In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of
Pumpkaboo takes the large spirits of adults to the
afterlife.

label: ZKN_ZA_0710_003
text:
In keeping with the size of its body, this variety of
Pumpkaboo takes jumbo spirits to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_ZA_0711_001
text:
Small Gourgeist pretend to be children to fool
adults. Anyone who falls for the act gets carried
away to the hereafter.

label: ZKN_ZA_0711_002
text:
Large Gourgeist put on the guise of adults, taking
the hands of children to lead them to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_ZA_0711_003
text:
Jumbo Gourgeist aren’t picky. They will forcefully
drag anyone off to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_ZA_0713_001
text:
With its icy jaw, it swiftly plows across snowy
fields and mountains, in search of nutritious
vegetables people have stored in the snow.

label: ZKN_ZA_0716_001
text:
When the horns on its head shine in seven colors,
it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_001
text:
This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces
have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent’s
chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_002
text:
This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces
have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent’s
chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_003
text:
It’s hypothesized that it’s monitoring those who
destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave
where it lives.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_004
text:
Born when all of Zygarde’s cells have been
gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those
who harm the ecosystem.

label: ZKN_ZA_0718_005
text:
In response to people’s emotions during an
unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and
calms the situation with its unmatched power.

label: ZKN_ZA_0719_001
text:
This Pokémon is also known as the Royal
Pink Princess. The dazzling, sparkling diamond
on its forehead is a whopping 2,000 carats.

label: ZKN_ZA_0720_001
text:
This is Hoopa’s true form, in which it has
regained its sealed powers. The hole in its chest is
said to connect to another dimension.

label: ZKN_ZA_0740_001
text:
It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light
swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered
in a thick layer of ice.

label: ZKN_ZA_0768_001
text:
It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes.
Once they’ve been pushed to the brink of defeat,
it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.

label: ZKN_ZA_0778_001
text:
Mimikyu is sad that it may be exposed for what it
really is. It will take revenge on whoever broke the
neck of its disguise—no forgiveness.

label: ZKN_ZA_0780_001
text:
Drampa’s cells have been invigorated, allowing
it to regain its youth. It manipulates the
atmosphere to summon storms.

label: ZKN_ZA_0801_001
text:
This Magearna looks as it did at the time of its
invention. Its magnificent ornamentation
delighted the king’s daughter.

label: ZKN_ZA_0801_002
text:
This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode
activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to
feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.

label: ZKN_ZA_0801_003
text:
A mechanism to remove Magearna’s limitations
has lain secretly within Magearna for 500 years.
This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.

label: ZKN_ZA_0807_001
text:
It stores up 10 lightning strikes’ worth of
electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it’s
in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.

label: ZKN_ZA_0849_001
text:
On its chest is an electricity-generating organ. A
sound like that of a bass guitar echoes all around
while this organ produces electricity.

label: ZKN_ZA_0870_001
text:
Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle
formation, which can be achieved only if the
troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.

label: ZKN_ZA_0876_001
text:
These Pokémon are highly intelligent. They touch
horns with their fellow Indeedee to share
information with one another.

label: ZKN_ZA_0877_001
text:
Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence,
and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted
into a Dark-type energy.

label: ZKN_ZA_0952_001
text:
Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon’s
spiciness. It swings its “necktie” around to wallop
its foes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0998_001
text:
Baxcalibur’s dorsal blade has grown even more
massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon
fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_001
text:
Even if swallowed by a foe, Tatsugiri will try to
make its escape through various means, such as
by inflating its throat sac.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_002
text:
Tatsugiri assesses situations using its sharp
intellect. If it determines there is no hope of
winning, it flees as fast as it can.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_003
text:
Tatsugiri’s brain has been invigorated by Mega
Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and
command copies of itself.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_004
text:
It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution,
building up an overflowing pile to launch as
projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.

label: ZKN_ZA_0978_005
text:
Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a
dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total
freedom—even through the air.

label: ZKN_ZA_0931_001
text:
Squawkabilly with blue plumage are the second
most populous variety after their green
counterparts, which they view as foes.

label: ZKN_ZA_0931_002
text:
Squawkabilly with yellow plumage grew
increasingly aggressive in order to be taken
seriously by the more populous varieties.

label: ZKN_ZA_0931_003
text:
This is the least populous variety of Squawkabilly.
They don’t like conflict, but when they have to
fight, they do so valiantly and resolutely.

label: ZKN_ZA_0970_001
text:
Glimmora’s petals—now larger and separated
from its main body—rotate around it to provide
defense while scattering poisonous fragments.

label: ZKN_ZA_0999_001
text:
If it senses it’s about to be found by a human or a
Pokémon, Gimmighoul will turn invisible to
protect itself, leaving only its coin visible.
